title: Jesus... It's 3 AM And My Heart Is Counting. 🌙
topic: she keeps waking at 3 AM with her heart counting what she doesn't have, waiting through the dark hours as if morning has forgotten her

bible.text: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... it's 3 AM again and my heart is counting everything I don't have. 🌙

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: The house is quiet and my chest isn't. I keep checking the clock.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're waiting like the night is in charge. It isn't. Morning was scheduled long before tonight.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why does waiting feel like being forgotten? Nobody sees the hours I hold.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The watchman waits for morning with one certainty: it comes. I hold the hours with you.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Hope isn't pretending the night is short. It's knowing who holds the morning.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to someone lying awake at 3 AM again. ⏰
